derivedMetrics.label: Debt/Total Capital
derivedMetrics.expression: (ST Debt + LT Debt) / (ST Debt + LT Debt + Equity)

derivedMetrics.label: Net Debt
derivedMetrics.expression: ST Debt + LT Debt + Lease Liabilities - Cash

derivedMetrics.label: Invested Capital
derivedMetrics.expression: Equity + ST Debt + LT Debt - Cash
